{"metadata":{"description":"Bring open-mcp-apps into deepseek-harness: apps as sidebar containers with their own sessions, an agent status strip, and inline widget rendering","id":"gh:1335034901","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-open-app","slug":"2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","mcp","mcp-apps"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Bring open-mcp-apps into deepseek-harness: apps as sidebar containers with their own sessions, an ag"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ent status strip, and inline widget rendering"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Makes every open-mcp-apps app **a place you go**
inside DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): an Apps
section in"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" the sidebar, one container per app with its own workspace and conversation, and
inline rendering wh"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"en the model opens an app mid-chat."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"| **Package** | `@2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app` on npm — MIT (LICENSE) |
| **Install** | `dsh plugin -"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"-profile web add @2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app` — one step |
| **Requires** | `dsh` with a web profile"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" · **pnpm** on `PATH` (`dsh plugin` manages profile dependencies through it) · a running **open-mcp-"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"apps v0.5.1+** · Node 22+ |
| **Platform** | dsh **web** (`dsh web`) — every surface it takes is a w"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"eb slot |
| **Releases** | CHANGELOG.md |"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Developer preview.** dsh is itself a `0.1.0-rc` preview, and this plugin tracks it
> closely — i"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ncluding six places where it reaches into dsh through no published seam (all
> six are listed under "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"What it reaches into,
> with what each degrades to). Expect breaking changes between releases, and p"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"in a version
> if you need one that holds still."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **`dsh` with a web profile** (`dsh web`). Every surface this plugin takes is a web slot.
- **pnpm "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"on `PATH`.** Not something this plugin depends on: `dsh plugin` is a thin forwarder
that runs `pnpm`"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" in the profile directory, so this is how any dsh plugin is installed.
Without it the install comman"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"d above stops at
`dsh: pnpm not found on PATH — install pnpm to manage profile plugins` and exits 12"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"7.
No minimum version is stated here because none has been measured.
- **A running open-mcp-apps eng"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ine with its HTTP face up** — `node src/http.mjs`, default
port `8787`. The engine is a separate ins"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"tall (its README):
it gives a model persistent, interactive UI apps backed by durable data collectio"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ns,
shared with every other host talking to the same engine. This plugin is the dsh face of them.
- "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"**Engine v0.5.1 or newer.** That release carries the three seams the panel leans on:
`?chrome=0` (th"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"e bare widget instead of the engine's own viewer bar), `?nav=intent`
(an app→app link becomes a mess"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"age to the host instead of a navigation inside the frame),
and the standalone viewer's root `overflo"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"w-y:auto`. Against an older engine the plugin
still works and degrades gracefully — each case is cal"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"led out under
Known limitations.
- **Optional, for per-app inline views:** start the engine with `OM"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"A_DYNAMIC_TOOLS=1`, which
is what makes it publish one `open_<app>` tool per app. The universal `ope"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"n_app` tool
is always covered."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Both opt-in query parameters are additive: an engine that has not heard of either ignores
it and kee"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ps its own behaviour. Nothing else is asked of the engine, and no dsh source is
changed — the plugin"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" runs entirely out-of-tree."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### What it adds"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| **Apps section in the sidebar** | *All apps* (the directory), *App Store* (where new ones come fro"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"m), and one node per pinned app. |
| **App containers** | Clicking an app node opens that app's work"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"space and its own session, with the app's UI on top and its history underneath. |
| **App mode** | A"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" container's agent gets a prompt of its own — who it is here, the app's card (what it is, the collec"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"tions its rows live in, their shape, the functions it declares), what it must not call, how short a "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"reply should be. It is a system-prompt section, assembled fresh for every request in a session that "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"lives in an app directory, and it costs an ordinary chat session nothing. The container's session al"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"so runs on an **App mode** preset, so dsh names the mode where dsh names modes. |
| **An opening lin"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"e** | A brand-new container is asked one question — "What is in the app right now?" — because a sess"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"ion dsh has never been spoken to gets no view ring, and because the answer is the first line of the "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"strip under the app. |
| **Apps tab ahead of Chat** | Registered at order `-10`, so the app leads an"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"d the conversation follows. Chat and Trajectory keep their seats. |
| **The agent's presence** | A o"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ne-line strip under the app: what the agent is doing right now (the tool it is calling, the answer a"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"rriving), what it last said, and — unmissably — when it is waiting for you or has failed. It reads a"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"s speech, not as source: the line is set in dsh's own content column and the model's markdown is rea"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"d out flat, since nothing here can typeset it. Click it for the whole conversation. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **The opening line is one model call per app.** See above; `installMessage: ''` opts
out, at the c"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ost of the blank-session layout and of the strip's first receipt. The
rules are unaffected — they ar"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"e a system section, and `containerPrompt: ''` is what
retires those.
- **A container that never got "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"its opening line has no tab ring.** dsh renders no
view until a session has its first message. Until"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" then the app renders in a row of its
own above the composer (`conversation.input.dock`) — live and "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"interactive, never
covering the input — and moves into the Apps tab the instant the ring appears.
- "},{"id":"p12s7","text":"**An app's conversations are hidden from the session tree, not just its workspace.**
Hiding the work"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"space alone would drop its sessions into the Ungrouped bucket, so they
are hidden with it (through d"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"sh's own archived-session set, in this client's
projection only — nothing is archived on the host). "},{"id":"p12s10","text":"They are still reachable the way
they are meant to be: through the app.
- **The App Store's "open" n"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"eeds an engine that knows `?nav=intent`** (v0.5.1+). An older
engine ignores the parameter, and the "},{"id":"p12s12","text":"store's links navigate its own frame instead of
entering the other app's container.
- **An app talle"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"r than the panel needs an engine that keeps its viewer scrollable.**
The panel gives every app the s"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"ame height, and an app whose document is taller than
that has to scroll inside it. Seven of the ship"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"ped apps declare
`html,body{overflow:hidden}` — correct advice to a host that sizes the frame from t"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"he
app, and in a fixed frame it means the wheel does nothing (measured: habit-streaks at
1712×537, d"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"ocument 1127px, nothing in the tree scrollable, 590px unreachable). The
engine's viewer (v0.5.1+) se"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"ts `overflow-y:auto` on the root of a standalone page,
which costs nothing when the app fits — on an"},{"id":"p12s19","text":" older engine those apps are clipped at
the fold, in a browser tab exactly as in this panel.
- **A s"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"andboxed app's links are not intercepted.** Apps installed `--sandboxed` run in
the runner's own chi"},{"id":"p12s21","text":"ld document; the click interception lives in the document the
